lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, approximately circular blobs arranged in vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The spacing between centroids increases progressively toward the posterior and ventral regions of the visible flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a geometric grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient where the upper edge of the ridge reflects light and the lower edge creates a recessed shadow.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high density of smaller, more irregular high-luminance clusters compared to the larger, more structured blobs on the main flank.
